sentences.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
sentences.zh: 这个职位要求申请人具备流利的英语口语能力。

sentences.en: We are expecting a lot of applicants for the job.
sentences.zh: 我们期待有很多应聘者申请这份工作。

sentences.en: I prepared a list of more qualified applicants for you.
sentences.zh: 我为你准备了一份更有资格的申请人名单。

senses.zh: 申请人（尤指求职、进高等学校等）
